name: SNP Schneider-Neureither & Partner SE
summary: SNP Schneider-Neureither & Partner SE provides software and consulting services for SAP transformations and data management. The company offers mergers and acquisitions, cloud data integrations, system decommissioning, and the Kyano platform for data management and migration. It serves businesses across multiple industries in 20 countries. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Heidelberg, Germany. SNP Schneider-Neureither & Partner SE is a subsidiary of Succession German Bidco Gmbh.
